chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Musanna, from Abi Baseer, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, the souls of the disbelievers are in the Fire of Hell, being presented to it. They say: 'Our Lord, do not establish the Hour for us, and do not bring to completion what You promised us, and do not join our later ones with our former ones.'

key_terms.آخِرَنَا بِأَوَّلِنَا: Our later ones with our former ones

ai.seo_question: What do the souls of disbelievers say in Hell regarding the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to elucidate the intermediate state of disbelievers' souls before the final resurrection, emphasizing their acute awareness of impending retribution. The supplication reflects a desperate desire to delay the 'Hour' (Yawm al-Qiyamah) and the execution of the divine promise, revealing their psychological torment as they anticipate the final reckoning. This highlights the Shia theological view that the soul experiences a distinct phase of judgment and anticipation prior to the bodily resurrection.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Najran, from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The souls of the Infidels are in the Fire of Hell, being presented to it. They are saying, ‘Our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not Establish the Hour for us, and do not Accomplish what You<sup>azwj</sup> Promised us, and do not Join our later ones with our former ones’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Najran from Muthanna from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the souls (spirits) of the unbelievers are exposed to hellfire. They say, ‘O Lord, do not make any Day of Judgment for us. Do not allow what You have promised us to come true and do not join the last of us with our first ones.’”
